cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: Three knocks. My sister used to do that through the wall when the lights went out.

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: You taught the whole ferry that one, Captain Vale. It could be anybody aboard.

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: Astra approach. Civilian traffic cleared to lift. Safe passage confirmed.

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: That's the rescue channel. Look at the approach. There's a cruiser parked across it.

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: Six worlds got that same clearance. At dawn the civilian convoys lift. The Lantern went early. Now she's drifting.

cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: That's the foundry on Ignis. They fired our first heat shield in that kiln. Now the night shift is making tiles for the ferries, and their own roofs are burning.

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: Cryo's maternity ward moved into the greenhouse. The nurses scratch little windows in the frost so the parents can see who's inside.

cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: Every lit room in that hotel on Vespera is a family waiting for a berth. Last night the power went out. Look. They found candles.

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: The clinic on Xylo grows reeds that clean the air for its patients. The nurses want to know if roots count against the baggage allowance.

cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: Tell them to bring the whole garden.

cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: That lighthouse on Thalassa is where my sister learned to steer. Even with her engine dead, she'd know which way to point the bow.

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: Kharon's keeper still has the old approach to Astra. When the relay fell she drew it on ration cards. She gave one to every pilot.

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: Tomas. I know the voice on that beacon. It's mine. They copied the clearance I gave your sister. I told her it was safe.

cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: Stay with me, Lark. We clear the ground lane, break the blockade above it, then bring them home. One world at a time.

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: What do I send the Lantern?

cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: Two knocks. She knows that means I'm coming.
